nom: La Roche-Posay Lipikar Body Lotion Daily Repair Moisturizing Lotion for Dry Skin

avis.texte: Product has been amazing and so smooth for my skin especially living in a desert. Will continue to use!!!
Not bad, but I feel like it's not the best for my combination skin. Maybe it would be perfect for combination skin that tends to be dry.

Pros: This actually works. It repaired my dry winter skin like no other. I'll even dab a little on my lips at night (with vaseline over top) and the results are incredible. I have very sensitive skin so I avoid lathering it on areas that are particularly sensitive. But it has never given me a rash or irritation. Cons: There is a greasy feeling to it. It is something you can definitely feel for a little while before it fully melts into your skin. It has a tacky feel.

avis.titre: Very moisturizing, but smells like oil
avis.texte: This product is amazing, especially for those with eczema. Very moisturizing and thick. Its very easy to overdo it, though. So it is best to apply on damp skin. If you use too much, it smells like cooking oil.

My Ulta store was out of my Laroche Posay daily facial moisturizer. I was informed I could use the product above "use it on your face and all over". This product broke my face out significantly. I returned to the store 3 days later "when their truck would be in" and was finally able to purchase my Double Repair Face Moisturizer. I would not recommend use on face but on body only.

I typically do not have sensitive skin anywhere, other than my face. For some reason, I broke out using this and it caused very itchy skin, in which I purchased to help that issue. I used it 3 days and had to stop. Used it again 2 weeks later for 2 days, and had to stop again.

I have very dry skin and have had a hard time finding something that is moisturizing without feeling greasy and you don't have to reapply. This lotion is exactly what I have been looking for. No scent which is an added plus.

This lotion is light and nourishing, perfect for everyday use. It's not heavily scented, which I appreciate, and it isn't as thick as the version made for very dry skin. It works well for maintaining soft, healthy skin without feeling heavy or greasy.

avis.titre: I will definitely keep using this product !
avis.texte: My face is already looking and feeling better after just a week. I will continue to use this and will absolutely recommend to friends.

I love this product. While not too expensive, you can use it all over. It's soft and makes your skin feel soft while moisturizing!!! I ahve used many expensive moisturizers and I think this is better than any others that I have used!!!
I have used this mouisturizer for years!! Keep comming back to it all the time.

Ive never had problems with La Roche products. I tried using this for two weeks and give it a chance, but every time it burned my fash and gave me a red rash. Really disappointed since the reviews are great.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this product again & again
avis.texte: Love it ! My skin is so hydrated and healthier looking so soft to the touch

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I love this stuff and so does my family , I'm so glad I got this , definitely will be buying more and using daily

This is my go to body lotion for my sensitive skin. It has improved the texture and health of my skin without any irritation. It's a must for me during the winter months to keep my skin hydrated and happy.

I bought this product for my daughter and husband (they have horrible dry skin). They've been using this daily as a body moisturizer. It's been working. After a month of use, they have smooth hydrated skin. I've used it in a hurry on my arms and legs and it feels really good on my skin. It's almost empty and will buy more. I'm keeping this in our household winter moisturizing arsenal.
This is the best moisturizer. Great for dry skin and can use everywhere not just your face.
Started using about a week ago my whole is broken out in little red pimples. Never had a lotion break me out

I really love this. I'm pretty picky with skin products since I worked in the beauty industry for decades and I'm in my 50s. I loved this so much I tried the triple repair thinking it would be even better for dry skin. Nope. This makes my skin feel and look so much better so I came back to this. It's a perfect staple for long lasting moisture for face or body.. neck especially. It's nice and thick, has no scent and good for sensitive dry skin. Apply on damp skin!

I use this as my daily face moisturizer and it works great. This is a lotion, not a cream, so it's water based and works well for my oily skin because it absorbs quickly without residue. I like that it doesn't make it worse like other moisturizers (also doesn't cure my oiliness but thats not the point). It's an easy pump to grab in the mornings and has lasted me so long. Happy I found this product.
Loved the triple moisturizer. Trying this one out. Definitely a lighter cream but keeps face soft and smooth.

Every skin is different. The first fee times i used this product i loved it and loved the price. But it ended up ruining my skin, my skin broke out. I now have bunch of red dots on my face. And have stopped using this product. My skin didnt love it, but who know it might work for you.
It helps a lot with my extremely dry skin, it doesn't leave me feeling sticky, and my skin stays moisturized all day.
I wanted to love this product but it pills to bad even with any of the other La Roche Posay products

Absolutely love. I have been using oil moisturizers as I thought they were lighter and absorbed quickly. But this cream is super light and absorbs quickly. it doesn't feel greasy and lasts all day. Now I can really feel the difference when I don't use it. If you are hesitant between this product and the triple repair one for extra dry skin I'd go with this one first. The other is a lot heavier and doesn't absorb as well

This is an amazing product for all/over hydration, rich but not heavy or greasy. The problem is that after using 2/3rds of the bottle, the pump becomes useless and you need to cut the container to get the product out. The company came out with a new squeeze container made of some kind of paper making it more sustainable material and easier to use throughout the life of the product, but the top was designed so that it was always in the way of the product coming out. Now I don't see that container anywhere and we are back to the original issue. Im hoping they are contributors work on a solution, otherwise this product would be 5 stars!

avis.titre: Love this product & solution for remaining 4 0unces
avis.texte: Again the best body lotion ever! But what to do when the pump won't get to the remaining 4 ounces of lotion. I have a solution! I cut the the top off with a knife, the take a spatula or kitchen knife and scrape it out and into a 4 ounce bell canning jar. Perfect size & then nothing is wasted.

I have the La Roche-Posay face moisturizer, which I love, so I figured I'd give this a shot. I only use this on my arms because they are the driest part of my body and WOW. My arms are so smooth and soft that I might stop using my other body moisturizer!
The lotion I ordered is very watery this time and I don't like it. I'm used to buying it very thick

avis.titre: Holy grail moisturizer for acne prone sensitive skin!
avis.texte: This is an amazing basic cleanser for any skin type! I have dry/combo sensitive skin that's acne prone and this works well for me. It isn't drying and leaves my face feeling nice and clean. I can use it around my eyes without irritation and that's a plus! It also doesn't break me out which is a huge factor for me. It's also fragrance free. I love the ingredients and how it has a pump that locks.

It's smells horrible once you've rubbed it in. 🤢 like moldy, fishy, dough. Which is odd cause it says fragrance free and I was really excited to use this but I don't know if I'll be able to tolerate the smell.

C'mon...you can do better! Fix the terrible scent! As other reviewers have pointed out, this lotion is *not* fragrance-free. It smells like fishy, plastic-y dough. Would not recommend it and would give it a zero-star rating if I could.

I really love it will definitely purchase again but like others have said it has a smell to it almost like a cheap mayo smell 😭 it does leave a greasy feel up until it absorbs into your skin but the upside is it leaves your skin sooo soft!
I have been using their products for a while and my skin has become really hydrating. I use it as a part of my morning routine and leaves skin light and refreshing.
Great product and so moisturizing. The fact that it's thick and doesn't dispense from the pump is a problem. I wont repurchase until they figure this out.

This felt really smooth going on. However, it did not sink into the skin very fast. My arms were sticky for about an hour after application. Also, it smells like play-dough. I literally STUNK. And I bought this mainly because it was "fragerance free"
It does the job and it's big enough. I usually use for my body my hands etc but i wanna wash it off smells disgusting.
love this lotion! It is light and refreshing. I also use the cleanser on me and baby.

Good product though issue with the pump. After first use I have to pull up the pump in order to dispense again. It's very inconvenient as it takes longer to get enough to put on. Unfortunately I won't be buying again due to this.

I'm a bilateral above knee amputee and need to keep the residual skin soft and moisturized. Due to 5 operations on one of my legs my skin looked red and bumpy like an orange peel. Since I purchased you product it has softened the skin and the redness bumpy appearance of of the area. The fact that this product may be used all over the body is wonderful and no need to purchase another product for the face. This product does it all and I'm extremely satisfied. That you for developing such a great product!
Good body lotion but too small for the price. Overall a good product
Great product, terrible packaging. Please update the pump. 25% of the product is almost always unusable as the pump is unable to expel it out.

I love how thick and creamy this lotion is. I don't like that it's so thick that when you get near the bottom it won't come out. Rather have it in a tub. I'd definitely repurchase this. Leaves my skin moisturized and soft.

My go to body lotion forever! I have extremely dry skin and live in the desert so I need a good daily lotion and this is my go to now for several years. There is no scent so I mix in a touch of oil or other lotion that smells great if I want some fragrance, otherwise happy with no scent. It's very hydrating without being greasy. It's a winner!

La Roche-Posay Lipikar Lotion is a game-changer for men's skincare because it's one and done type of thing. While the lightweight, non-greasy formula is perfect for fuss-free application. This lotion hydrates and soothes all day, making it great for those with a hectic routine. Fragrance-free, it suits even my time to time sensitive skin. In summary, Lipikar is a must-have for men looking for a simple, effective solution for dry skin.

I love this lotion! Although it can be used on the body and face, I primarily use it just on my face. It does not clog up my pores, it's lightweight enough but still hydrating, and the scent is not overwhelming at all. You get a ton of product for the price! I would recommend!

This is a great light lotion to use at work. It leaves my hands feeling soft and it is not too greasy feeling. It can be a little pricier than other brands so my only improvement would be is lowering the cost to other competitors
I love how soft my skin feels after using this body lotion every morning after my shower. It's lightweight, fast to absorb and my skin feels moisturized the entire day! I'll definitely buy it again!
I use La Roche Posay products for a long time now but never saw this moisturizer before. This lotion is a miracle for my skin leaving soft and moisturize ￼

This is a solid choice for an all around good moisturizer. It's not too thin, nor to thick. Great for a swing that normal, not dry but not so oily. I wish it had a fragrance but that's just a personal opinion. I'll always keep a bottle of this brand lotion around for family use.
I love this body lotion especially during the winter time. It contain ingredients good for the skin and overall every product from this brand is a winner.

Absolutely love how this moisturized my face! Sadly this stuff was making my eyes itch and burn so bad for months before i figured out this was the reason. Once i stopped using it my eyes are fine! Sad - because it really moisturized well!

I love having shea butter and glycerine in my body moisturizers! This one is so good. As an esthetician, I'm always recommending this one to my clients for their all over body moisturizer. Packaging is clean- they didn't have to do much and it still looks good. The ingredients are what matters most to this.
I would purchase again, a tab but on the pricey side but leave your skin moisturizer and feeling great. No scent and digs deep to the pores. This is my second time purchase, I have sensitive skin.

I bought this thinking it would be better than the regular lotion because of the brand and price but its not as hydrating, it goes on skin smoothly and penetrates fast but it still didn't make a difference on my dry skin in the long run. I was disappointed as I love their cleansers but for body lotions I will have to stick with gold bonds.
It's been a while since I used this. I remember it being thick and hard to rub in, but very hydrating. I would use again.
This product stinks. Thought I would still be able to use it but I can't get past the smell.

avis.titre: I love this moisturizer for the face and body
avis.texte: This moisturizer works amazing !!! I love that it's for the face and body . It definitely makes your skin moist and soft. You will see a big difference in your body and face once you start using it
This is my all time favor holly grail moisturizer. I have psoriasis and this has changed my life and my skin. Does not make feel oily just hydrated.

avis.titre: Great for my bad skin days!
avis.texte: This product is great for those days when my skin is SUPER dry, however don't use this product if you have combination-oily skin because it can over-hydrate your skin.

This stuff is addictive it's so good it's thick so for dry skin it's perfect it makes your skin smooth soft hydrated it's affordable for the amount you get it's fragrance free which is another big plus it can be used on babies
It's and good product it just takes alittle while too absorb into the skin it alittle toooo watery if your getting what I mean!! So you pick you battles w this one.

I bought this lotion two weeks ago and I can't stop using it. I have incredible dry skin and nothing seemed to hydrate my body. Once I started using this lotion everything changed. I don't even have to apply consistently every hour because it keeps my skin hydrated for that long.
I loved this product. It was more hydrating than products that are incredibly more expensive. Would definitely buy again! The Minnesota winter months make this a necessity!

I've been using these products for over 4 years now. I first tried it at Walgreens and let me tell you.. this is in my daily skincare. I usually buy luxury brands but this one tops all of them! I put this all over my face morning and night. You can also put it on your body if you're dry as well. This product is affordable and it works.
Could not recommend this moisturizer enough, I will continue to repurchase for the rest of my life! It leaves my skin feeling so amazing and I could not live without it

avis.titre: dried my skin out so much
avis.texte: i used this and my skin immediately dried out and didn't hydrate or anything. i was very disappointed because of the price. i expected so much more. it gave me rashes and more pimples.

This body lotion is the only thing that keeps me from scratching off my dry, sensitive skin in the winter. It is thick and takes a while to sink in but forms a sort of protective layer over the skin (I do not feel this when my skin is dry but notice it when I shower it off). This product is unscented but smells kind of like play doh. While this lotion works great on my body, it breaks my face out, possibly due to the shes butter

avis.titre: Not just for the body but the face as well!
avis.texte: I use the La Roche-Posay Lipikar Body Lotion and I must say, it has become an essential part of my skincare routine. This lotion not only delivers exceptional hydration but also provides a gentle and nourishing experience when applied to both the body and face. What I love most about this body lotion is its lightweight and non-greasy formula. It absorbs quickly into my skin, leaving it feeling silky smooth and moisturized without any residue. The texture is perfect for daily use, as it doesn't weigh down or clog pores when applied to the face. La Roche-Posay Lipikar Body Lotion is formulated with ingredients that are safe and beneficial for the skin, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It is enriched with shea butter and glycerin, which provide intense hydration and help restore the skin's natural moisture barrier. Not only does this lotion provide excellent hydration, but it also soothes any dryness or irritation. I have noticed a significant improvement in the overall texture and appearance of my skin since incorporating this lotion into my routine. The packaging is also practical and hygienic, with a pump dispenser that allows for easy and controlled application. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts for a considerable amount of time. Overall, I highly recommend La Roche-Posay Lipikar Body Lotion for both body and face. Its gentle and nourishing formula delivers long-lasting hydration without any irritation or greasiness. Say goodbye to

To start I have really sensitive skin like I break out like crazy with the wrong product to give you a bit of my background. I also have combination skin so it makes finding the right face lotion. This is pretty good but it does tend to feel a bit heavy on my face and feels a little greasy. HOWEVER, if you only have dry skins this would probably be a good fit. It also is a bit pricey but since I use only a little to help with the heavy and greasiness it lasts me a long time like I got it 3? Months ago and I don't think I'm even halfway through
This makes my skin extremely soft and it lasts for the whole.day! I have and will recommend this product always! The bottle last quite long as well.

This body lotion is very nicely priced. It had a very thick consistency so it's especially good for those with drier skin. Also has ingredients for those with with sensitive skin and is fragrance free!
I bought it cause I've seen it on the TV I really needed a good lotion for my skin and yes indeed I Love it wouldn't trade it for nothing else I love it. Thankfully Laurina NYC.

avis.titre: Yes for the body, No for the face
avis.texte: I love it on my dry legs and arms. Texture is nice, unscented, and skin stays hydrated. However, I used it on my face for 2 days and ebded up with acne, which I never get. I also don't like how my face is very greesy when I wake up.
This product is good. But unfortunately I cannot use it because the smell of it is terrible. I wish I would have purchased something else.
the best body lotion i've ever used. skin is soft and hydrated for the entire day

Did anyone else experience severe pilling with this lotion? I could be fresh out of the shower and apply one layer of this lotion and over the next few hours it would pill off. Other brands did not do this? I had originally used the cream version of this la roche posay product and it soaked in fine and I really liked it, but the lotion version felt too liquidy and no matter what I tried to do differently, it still pilled every time.
I love this lotion. It's light and quenching. Great lor shaved legs and dishwater hand.
Just started using this and it has been a game changer for my super sensitive and dry skin. Affordable, simple packaging and very light scent if any at all.
This is a great facial moisturizer, it pairs well with my serums when I do my skin care routine. It's not to heavy, goes good as a body moisturizer for the summer because it's light.
This lotion has saved my life! I have really dry skin and it saves me all day. I put it on before I go to work and it keeps me moisturized all day. Never looking back.

I love all things from La Roche Posay and this stunning body lotion takes the cake. I struggle with keratosis Polaris- this lotion practically eliminates the breakouts for me. It smells good and a little bit goes a long way. Highly recommend.
I have super super dry skin so my friend suggested to try this product and it's made such a huge difference, my skin doesn't feel so dry anymore. It's nice and smooth

avis.titre: Clears skin so amazing makes my skin feel very moi
avis.texte: I love it so much I have very dry skin and it helps so muchhhhh I love ittt!! Like omg I will be purchasing over and over and over because this stuff is perfectttt
The lotion keeps my skin nice and hydrated for hours, it's amazing!!! Love that the lotion works both for body and face not leaving your face all sticky and sweaty.

I have had itchy dry skin no other "moisturizing" lotion would help . I got this and my skin has cleared up and stopped itching in less than a week . Its thick and moisturizing.. the only problem I have is it feels a little greasy , but it done what I needed so I will deal with it .

Scentless, thick, whipped lotion that feels invisible on the skin. Once I used it for a month, I skipped a day in between applying it and my super dry, rough skin was anything but! Makes your skin look glowy and smooth

avis.titre: Good for dry, acne prone skin
avis.texte: I have a hard time finding a moisturizer that is hydrating but also does not cause an acne flair up. This is it for me. I use trentinoin and this really helps with dryness and keeps my fave clear. Very simple lotion but a repurchase for me.

the absolute BEST moisturizer i have ever used. my dermatologist recommended this to me and i've been in love ever since (about 6 months now). i use this on my face every day and my body when i need extra moisture. also, the bottle lasts FOREVER - i have at least 1/3 of the bottle left and have been using it daily (on my face) for about 5-6 months. i will use it forever! highly highly recommend this, and all of LRP's products (love their cleanser in the blue bottle as well - i think it's the one for normal/oily skin). i gave a little of it to my friend (maybe a month worth of product) and she also raved about it and bought her own bottle!
Hands down the best lotion ever. Living in the Midwest it gets so cold my skin cries for moisture! This lotion is the only thing that keeps my skin hydrated.

avis.titre: Instant moisture without greasiness or breakouts
avis.texte: Being prone to eczema, grateful for instantly hydrating my skin without breaking me out. It does not feel greasy when applying either and does a good job.
This is an amazing lotion for dry skin! I use it every night after I shower. My skin has never felt softer!! I definitely recommend for people with dry skin!

Having sensitive skin it's really hard to find products that won't cause my skin to become irritated. I use this lotion everyday with no problems. My skin feels amazing and smooth like a newborn's skin. I am in love with this!!!
This lotion leaves my skin feeling super moisturized and soft. However, it is quite thick so it takes a long time to rub in, and sometimes transfers onto other surfaces that I come in contact with.
This stuff seriously works. Makes your skin soo soft! Works on my toddler with eczema as well. I would say it's more of a cream consistency than lotion
I got an allergic reaction to it :( was really excited for it to be honest.
Made my skin feel baby smooth 😍 This has become a daily product for me. Smell is not strong but smells good. I will purchase another one when I am out.

I thought maybe it was just me or I got a bad batch, but judging by other reviews, it seems it's the new formulation of this lotion? It has a weird and nasty smell that I can't get past. It's supposed to be fragrance-free, but as soon as you put it on, it has this strange plasticy fishy smell. It's too bad because it's hydrating and easy to put on. Such a waste but I can't stand how I smell! Wish the company would listen to it's customers and either change the formula back to what it was or correct this issue. Don't waste your money unless you want to smell funky. Blech.

Used to be amazing, now it sucks, they reformulated a perfect product for no reason, now it's way too watery and smells weird, please switch back to the old one no one wants this there was nothing wrong with the original. The new formula is horrible. Why???

I got a mini sample size version of this product in a gift set at Christmas & just recently ran out. I found myself missing it so much! It made my skin so incredibly soft and moisturized after just one use. When I went to buy a full size version, I accidentally bought the one for eczema, which also works great but does have a slight smell to it that I definitely notice on myself. Almost like a fried food smell? If you don't have extremely dry skin, I'd recommend this version of the product over the eczema version
I love using this lotion after I apply tretinoin. It feels so good on my skin and my face is still moisturized in the morning. I love that it repairs my skin barrier during the night.
Unscented lotion that applies smoothly and nicely! It's super hydrating without feeling oily and stick on the skin. Leaves my skin feeling super soft!
i had the worst dry skin and this body lotion easily repaired my skin and brought moisture back to it. it is very thick but it feels so nice on and is long lasting

avis.titre: Super Hydrating moisturizer for Dry Skin!
avis.texte: This moisturizer was very nourishing however it is more on the thicker side. Definitely for more dry skin and for those days that you need more hydration.

I have dry and reactive skin and my dermatologist PA recommended this face cream to me! I love it! I apply it twice a day morning and evening. It could be too heavy for some that don't have dry skin. I also wear it under makeup.
Great price. Seems thin when you pump it into your hands but feels luxurious on the skin. The softness lasts for days without reapplying. Very inpressive lotion.
This product is my go to moisturizer during the winter. It is a thick moisturizer but it leaves your skin supple and soft. It almost feels like an oil when robbed in into the skin.

avis.titre: Great product for dry and sensitive skin!
avis.texte: The lotion works well for dry skin. It's fragrance free, makes skin so soft and it's well absorbed. It works very well when the weather is cold and dry to relieve itchy. I don't use the lotion on my face as I have oily skin in the T-Zone, when applied, my face will be too oily but no problem with using the lotion on my body 😉
La roche posay lipikar lotion is great body moisturiser for normal to dry skin,very moisturising All my family including kids use it ,I highly recommended

This is my go to moisturizer! I am usually of very dry skin year round and this moisturizer has not disappointed! Ever since I found this, I never wanna go back into anything else I feel like it really helped heal and clear up my skin! I adore this brand so much just based off this product that I want to try all products. They knew what they were doing when they were creating this but I usually use this as my facial moisturizer and it's made me very glowy with and without makeup! I use it on my body as well and it's very well hydrating and lasts a very long time! It's a very thick consistency but that's what we need with dry skin! Hands down best moisturizer for dry skin on the market, if you don't have this on your counter, then what are you doing? Go get it!!!
I enjoy this body lotion for year round. It can feel greasy at times but overall keeps my skin nice and hydrated which I love. Would recommend if you prefer a heavier moisturizer.

I actually tried this product in a skincare advent calendar and immediately bought the bigger bottle. This lotion worked wonders for my skin. I live in a dry climate and this was game changing for me. 12/10 would recommend

avis.titre: Excellent product, bottle too small for body.
avis.texte: I love this lotion. It's lightweight while being very moisturizing and quickly absorbs. I use this for my entire body. 13.5 ounces is not much. I wish it came in larger bottles.

avis.titre: Excellent for all skins at home
avis.texte: As a mom with eczema I prevent any breakouts induced by stress on my skin but also use this product on my new born and my 8 year old son. This product leaves your skin not only smooth but moisturized.

I love this lotion and it has helped a lot with my flaky skin, but the pump sucks! It's a thick lotion so the pump doesn't suck it through correctly. If they would fix that problem, it would be a 10/10.

Oh my goodness can someone sue them? How is this a face lotion yet stings the crap out of my eyes. I've never had a reaction with any product from anywhere and can manage a brief interaction but I had to flush my eyes, use drops, and basically hold my eyes open because they hurt so bad. Do not use on your face
Excellent smooth yet mild and light face lotion…. Smooths the skin and last most all day ….Morning and night application after the cleanser

I wanted to try this as the old moisturizer I was using that I LOVED from Nivea apparently has a bad rating on Yuka (due to it containing some not so good for you chemicals). This has a great rating for clean ingredients and I also think la roche posay is pretty nice. One thing off the bat I really don't like is it doesn't sink in. I hate feeling sticky and this product definitely is kind of sticky. The texture was a surprising one to me but I'm trying to see past it. Another thing is that the pump on mine stopped working but I have like a little more than half of the product left so I have to like really work to get the product out of the container because it's super thick. Something I like is that it definitely is hydrating and makes my skin soft. However, like I said I'm sticky for literally hours. And it's not due to the amount of product I use either. Overall, I think this moisturizer does a decent job and it's a clean one which is why I'd recommend it. However, I am going to try to look into other options after I'm finished with this one
This lotion is a LIFESAVER for rashes or severely dry, cracked skin. During the winter, my skin gets so dry to the point where it's uncomfortable. I use this regularly for it and it does wonders.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: I noticed a dramactic difference in my skin after about a week's worth of use! The dry cold winter air did a number on my skin. This product saved it!

avis.titre: Great for sensitive and dry skin
avis.texte: Amazing hydration, no fragrance, literal all day hydration without feeling greasy. Perfect for all types of skin, specially sensitive. Dermatologist recommended
